name: DataGrid
summary: Power-user tabular surface built on Table. Adds column visibility toggle, column reorder, column resize, frozen / sticky columns, row selection (single / multi), row expansion, inline cell edit, density control, sort indicators on headers, filter chip row, grouped / aggregated / subtotal rows, and pivot. Sparingly use — most operator tables stay on the simpler Table primitive.

frozenStart.description: Number of leading columns to freeze (sticky-left).

frozenEnd.description: Number of trailing columns to freeze (sticky-right).

filters.description: Filter chip row state — map of columnId → filter spec.

groupBy.description: Group rows by a column id; render subtotal rows + the grand total.

rowVirtualization.description: When true, integrate with @tanstack/react-virtual or similar to render only visible rows.

keyboard: Tab - enter the grid; first cell focused
Home / End - first / last cell in row
Ctrl+Home / Ctrl+End - first / last cell in grid
PageUp / PageDown - scroll a page of rows
Enter - activate cell (open expansion, start inline edit)
rules: Row selection toggle has aria-label='Select row {label}'.
Frozen columns set position: sticky + outline at the frozen boundary so it's visually obvious.
Resize handle is keyboard-resizable per ArrowLeft/Right when focused.
Bulk-selection bar appears above the table, announces 'N rows selected' via aria-live='polite'.

do: Build DataGrid only when operator users need column reorder / freeze / inline edit. For static tables, use Table.
Persist user column preferences (visibility / order / width) in localStorage by tableId.
Surface filter chip row above the table (the FilterBar pattern).
Render selection bar above the table with count + bulk action buttons.
Use tabular-nums on numeric columns; right-align numbers.
dont: Don't put DataGrid features on a Table when the data is < 50 rows and read-only.
Don't render more than 1000 visible rows without virtualization.
Don't paint selected rows in lime fill; use action.selected.bg.

changelog.note: Initial DataGrid contract (beta). Power-user extensions to Table.
